title: RAML files with no implementation flows should lead to warning
description: Today, if I create a new APIkit project, add a RAML file to it, and have no implementation for that RAML file, I don't get any warning. Instead we should generate a runtime warning stating that a set of RAML files do not have associated implementation.     The example messaging should be:     The API specification file <file-name> has resources with no associated implementation.
